title: Jonah Elliss has an opportunity to win a starting job with the Broncos

sources.title: Jonah Elliss has an opportunity to win a starting job with the Broncos
sources.description: After a promising rookie season that saw Jonah Elliss total 5 sacks, expectations were high in year two for the Broncos pass rusher. He was still a reserve pass rusher behind starters Nik Bonitto and Jonathon Cooper, but looked to repeat or improve on the numbers he had last season. Unfortunately, due to injuries, Elliss […]
